scope: All31 programs/scripts listed in the forensic and other-tools sections; change log is a supporting file, not an extra program.
runtime_caveat: The site's blanket GUI/CLI runtime prose contradicts three GUI rows (Hasher, TimeApp, XWFIM) and three net9-only CLI rows (SQLECmd,VSCMount,WxTCmd). Table values recorded literally. Confirm available artifact and runtime against the current distribution before selecting a build.

tools.name: AmcacheParser
tools.purpose: Parses application/file inventory from Amcache.
tools.status: listed on official catalog; no deprecation claimed
tools.critical_limitations: Keep accompanying hive transaction logs; interpret records by Windows version, not as a universal execution proof.
tools.validation_status: documentation reviewed; binaries not downloaded or executed
tools.limitations_basis: official manual plus clearly conservative analysis guidance
